title: Sandyford logistics hub
summary: A 1,850 m² warehouse fit-out delivered in fourteen weeks while the building stayed operational.
brief: The tenant needed racking power, high-bay lighting and a new 400 A supply without interrupting inbound deliveries. The existing board had no spare ways.
outcome: We split the changeover across two weekends, ran temporary supplies to the cold rooms, and handed over a board with 18 spare ways and labelled submains. Illuminance at the racking face measured 310 lux against the 300 lux design target.
